summary: Brookfield Renewable Partners L.P. filed a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer current report, US equivalent of an 8-K) disclosing an extension of the voting deadline and a rescheduled special meeting for its proposed corporate structure simplification. Proxies cast to date show approximately 99.7% support, but approval requires at least two-thirds of all outstanding units, so turnout, not sentiment, is the binding constraint. The virtual meeting moves to November 30, 2026 (12:00 p.m. Toronto time), with the proxy cutoff at 5:00 p.m. Toronto time on November 25, 2026; the August 21, 2026 record date is unchanged. The board, acting on the unanimous recommendation of an all-independent nominating and governance committee and a Scotiabank fairness opinion, unanimously approved the plan of arrangement and recommends unitholders vote in favor; ISS and Glass Lewis also recommend FOR. Mechanics involve two resolutions — the arrangement resolution and an LPA amendment enabling the simplification. Watch the two-thirds quorum threshold and any last-minute turnout shortfall as the arb risk.
